questions.question: An object travels 10 m in 4 s and then another 14 m in 2 s. What is the average speed of the object?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Objects travels:

⇒ 10 m in 4 s

⇒ 14 m in 2 s

**Formula used:-**

⇒ Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:-**

As we know,

⇒ Average speed = Total Distance/Total Time

⇒ Total distance = 10 + 14 = 24 m

⇒ Total time = 4 + 2 = 6

⇒ Average Speed = 24/6 = 4 ms⁻¹

questions.question: 315 marbles are distributed among Aman, Ashok and Alok in the ratio 7 : 3 : 5, respectively. How many more marbles did Aman get compared to Ashok?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total number of marbles = 315

Ratio in which marbles are shared = 7 : 3 : 5

**Calculation:**

Let marbles distributed among Aman, Ashok and Alok be 7x : 3x : 5x

According to the question,

7x + 3x + 5x = 315

⇒ 15x = 315

⇒ x = 21

So,

Aman has marbles = 7 × 21 = 147

Ashok has marbles = 3 × 21 = 63

Aman gets more marbles than Ashok by = 147 - 63

⇒ 84

**∴ 84 more marbles did Aman get compared to Ashok.**

questions.question: One of the two inlet pipes works twice as efficiently as the other. The two can fill the empty cistern in 12 hours. A drain pipe can empty a cistern all by itself in 12 hours. How many hours will the more efficient inlet pipe take to fill the empty cistern by itself?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Efficiency of two inlet pipes = 2:1

The two can fill the empty cistern in 12 hours.

A drain pipe can empty a cistern all by itself in 12 hours.

**Concept used:**

Work done = efficiency × time

**Calculation:**

Efficiency of two inlet pipes = 2:1

We know that,

Work done = efficiency × time

⇒ (2 + 1) × 12 = 36

The more efficient inlet pipe take to fill the empty cistern by itself = 36/2

⇒ 18

**∴ The Required answer is 18**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Let the two inlet pipes be A and B.

Let the total work be 36 units and the efficiency of A and B be 2x and x.

∵ The two can fill the empty cistern in 12 hours,

∴ 36/(2x + x) = 12

⇒ x = 1

⇒ Time taken by more efficient pipe A = 36/2x = 36/2 = 18 hours

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__** A drain pipe can empty a cistern all by itself in 12 hours. It is given for only distract the Question. Don't confuse with irrelevant terms use in the question.

questions.question: 4x² + kx + 5 is divisible by x + 1. The same expression is also divisible by:
questions.solution:
⇒ 4x² + kx + 5 is divisible by (x + 1)

Now we can say x = (-1)

⇒ 4(-1)² + k(-1) + 5 = 0

⇒ 4 – k + 5 = 0

⇒ k = 9

⇒ 4x² + 9x + 5 = 0

⇒ 4x² + 5x + 4x + 5 = 0

⇒ x(4x + 5) + 1 (4x + 5) = 0

⇒ (4x + 5) (x + 1) = 0

Now, we can say 4x² + kx + 5 is also divisible by (4x + 5).

questions.question: Garima and her sister together can paint the walls of their house in 45 days. If Garima alone did the job, it would have taken her 81 days. If the duo started painting together but Garima’s sister had to leave 9 days before the completion of the work, how many days in all would it take the sisters to paint their house?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time

Efficiency ratio of Garima and (Garima’s sister + Garima) = 45 : 81 = 5 : 9

Efficiency of Garima’s sister + Garima = 9

Efficiency of Garima’s sister = 9 – 5 = 4

Total work = 45 × 9 = 405

Let the work be completed in x days

According to the question

⇒ 5x + 4(x – 9) = 405

⇒ 9x – 36 = 405

⇒ x = 49 days

questions.question:
You are given a question and two statements. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.

**Question:**

Nayan has 4 caps of 3 different colours. How many blue caps does he have?

**Statements:**

1. Nayan has 2 white caps.

2. The number of blue caps he has is the same as that of white caps.
questions.solution:
The two colours mentioned in this question are blue and white. Let us assume the third colour to be black.

 
• Statement 1: Nayan has 2 white caps

Given: Nayan has 4 caps of 3 “different” colours.

Thus, we have the following combination: 

 
• Case 1) 2 white caps and 1 blue cap

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2fbb7505f26cf5929dc5c92d7fae1a66827d6711d8186a213e71b24fcf95a42d.png] 

 
• Case 2) 2 white caps and 2 blue caps.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f626dde2f659af0ff0ba91402c961871b0f0b26df74b9b6894705932886b1fc3.png] 

This is not possible as 4 caps should have 3 different colours.

 
• Case 3) 2 white caps and 2 black caps

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80f947a869562e809f7c50e227bb95d3a16c06f91ecf2b75453d5c551fee36c8.png] 

 
• This is not possible as 4 caps should have 3 different colours.
 
• Thus, we can eliminate cases 2 and 3.
 
• Therefore, ***Nayan has 1 blue cap. ***
 
• ***Hence, statement 1 alone is sufficient to answer the question.***

 

 
• Statement 2: The number of blue caps he has is the same as that of white caps.
 
• Case 1) 1 white cap and 1 blue cap

This will imply that the remaining 2 caps are black

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43482a1e9a280e30f95e8d8ed9af7d7e45b440165decbb9183f623b509248a9f.png] 

 
• Case 2) 2 white caps and 2 blue caps.

 

 
• This case is not possible because there should be 3 different colours.
 
• Therefore, ***Nayan has 1 blue cap. Hence, statement 1 alone is sufficient to answer the question.***

Hence, statement 1 or 2 alone is sufficient to answer the question.

questions.question: A year ago, Akash’s father’s age was 9 times that of Akash. After 3 years his father’s age will be 5 times that of his age. How old will Akash be next year?
questions.solution:
Let one year ago age of Akash’s father be 9x and age of Akash be x.

According to the question

⇒ (9x + 4) / (x ­+ 4) = 5/1

⇒ 9x + 4 = 5x + 20

⇒ x = 4

∴ Age of Akash one year ago = 4 years

Present age of Akash = 4 + 1 = 5 years

∴ Age of Akash next year = 5 + 1 = 6 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59f594970a3cb6c03cfb3723d41169f1482b3088c45c211f647fe2ae092482d6.png] 

Let the present age of Akash be x.

Let the present age of Akash father be y.

For 1 year ago 

⇒ y - 1 = 9(x - 1)

⇒ y = 9x - 8

For after 3 years

⇒ y + 3 = 5(x + 3)

⇒ 9x - 8 + 3 = 5x + 15

⇒ 4x = 20

⇒ x = 5

Age of Akash next year = 5 + 1 = 6 years

**∴ The age of Akash next year is 6 years.**

questions.question: The ratio of the area of a square to the area of a regular hexagon, having the same perimeter is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A square and a regular hexagon have the same perimeter.

**Formula used:**

Area of square = (side)²

The perimeter of the square = 4 × side

Area of the hexagon = 6 × [√3/4] × a²

**Calculation:**

Let the perimeter of the hexagon and the square be 12 cm.

⇒ Side of the square = 12/4 = 3 cm

∴ Area of the square = 3 × 3 = 9 cm²

⇒ Side of the hexagon = 12/6 = 2 cm

⇒ Area of the hexagon = 6 × [√3/4] × a² = 6 × [√3/4] × 2 × 2 = 6√3

∴ Required ratio = 9 : 6√3 = √3 : 2

**Alternate Method:**

Let the perimeter of square and hexagon be x cm

Side of square = x/4

⇒ Area of square = (x/4)²

⇒ x²/16 cm² 

Side of hexagon = x/6

Area fo hexagon = 6 × [√3/4] × side2

Area fo hexagon = 6 × [√3/4] × (x/6)²

⇒ √3x²/24

Required ratio = (x2/16) : (√3x2/24)

**∴ The ratio of the area of a square to the area of a regular hexagon is √3 : 2**

questions.question: An electric bulb of 100 W is used 8 hours per day. The energy consumed by the bulb in one day is ______ units.
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Heating effect of electric current: When a current is flowing in a circuit having resistance there is heat dissipation due to the resistance. This is called the heating effect of electric current.

The heat dissipated is given by:

Heat (H) = I2 R t

Work done (W) = Heat (H) = **Energy consumed (E) **= Power (P) × Time taken (t)

Where I = the current flowing in the circuit, R = the resistance of the circuit, and t = the time taken 

CALCULATION__:

**Given,**

Power = 100 W, Time = 8 hours per day

We know that,

**Power (P) = Energy (E)/Time (t)**

Power = 100 W = 0.1 KW

0.1 = E/8

**Energy (E) = 0.8 KWh = 0.8 Unit in one day**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• 1 unit of electric energy: When a one-kilowatt load works for 1 hour then the energy consumed is called 1 unit of electricity.

1 Unit of electricity = 1 KWh = 1000 Watt-hour = 3.6 × 106 J

1 Kilo-watt = 1000 Watt

1 Hp = 1 horsepower = 746 Watt (W)

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work together in 15 days while A alone can do it in 25 days. They start working together but B leaves 5 days before the completion of the work. For how many days did A and B work together?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B can do a piece of work together = 15 days

A alone can do the work in = 25 days

B leaves 5 days before completion of the work

**Concept used:**

The efficiency ratio is inversely proportional to time for the same work

Work = time × efficiency 

**Calculation:**

Efficiency ratio of (A + B) and A = 25 : 15 = 5 : 3

Efficiency of B = 5 – 3 = 2

Efficiency ratio of A to B = 3 : 2

⇒ Total work = 5 × 15 = 75 units

In the last 5 days, only A does the work.

⇒ Work done by A in the last 5 days = 5 × 3 = 15 units

∴ Remaining work = 75 – 15 = 60 units

The remaining work is done by A and B together before B left.

∴ Time taken by A and B to complete 60 units = 60/5 = 12 days

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold two items, one at 25% profit and another at 15% loss and got a profit of Rs. 35. If the cost price of the item sold at 25% profit is twice than that of the item sold at 15% loss, find the sum of the cost price of both items.
questions.solution:
**Short trick:**

Let the cost price of the item that was sold at 15% loss be Rs. 100.

⇒ The selling price of the item that was sold at 15% loss is Rs. 85.

∴ The cost price of the item that was sold at 25% profit be Rs. 200.

⇒ The selling price of the item that was sold at 25% profit be Rs. 250.

Total selling price = 85 + 250 = Rs. 335

Total cost price = 100 + 200 = Rs. 300

Profit = 335 – 300 = Rs. 35

∵ These prices satisfy the given condition for the profit,

∴ The required cost price = 100 + 200 = Rs. 300

**Detailed solution:**

Let there are two item A and B.

Let the cost of A be Rs. 4x and cost of B be Rs. 20y [∵ 25% = 1/4 and 15% = 3/20]

⇒ SP of A = 4x × (5/4) = 5x

⇒ SP of B = 20y x (17/20) = 17y

Ratio of CP to SP of article A = 4 : 5 ---- (1)

Ratio of CP to SP of article B = 20 : 17 ---- (2)

Multiply by 10 in equation (1)

New ratio of CP to SP of article A = 40 : 50 ---- (3)

According to the question

Total CP of article A and B = (20 + 40 = 60) unit

Total SP of article A and B = (17 + 50 = 67) unit

⇒ Profit = 67 – 60 = 7 unit

⇒ 7 unit = 35

⇒ 1 unit = 5

Sum of CP of article A and B = (40 + 20) × 5 = 60 × 5 = Rs. 300

As we know,

Volume of sphere = (4/3) × πr³

Let n balls each of radius 1 cm be made from steel sphere 

According to the question

⇒ (4/3) × πR³ = n × (4/3) × πr³

⇒ 6 × 6 × 6 = n × 1 × 1 × 1

⇒ n = 216
